record.field: Summarise the open sales pipeline and flag risks.

You are my sales manager. Using read_group and search_records, review the current open pipeline. Break it down by salesperson and stage, highlight the largest opportunities, flag deals with no activity in the last {{days}} days, and end with three concrete actions for this week.
A concise cash, receivables and payables snapshot.

Act as my CFO. Build a snapshot of receivables and payables: total outstanding, overdue amounts bucketed by age, and the top ten customers by overdue balance. Use read_group for the aggregates. Present it as a short executive briefing with one paragraph of commentary.
Revenue by month with trend commentary.

Produce a revenue report for {{year}}. Use read_group on the relevant sales/invoicing model grouped by month, compare each month to the previous one, identify the best and worst months, and summarise the trend in three bullet points a board would read.
Find products below a stock threshold.

Act as my warehouse manager. Find products with on-hand quantity below {{threshold}} units. First call get_schema to confirm the stock fields, then search_records. Return a table sorted by urgency and suggest which to reorder first.

Give me a 360-degree view of the customer "{{customer}}". Use name_search to resolve them, then gather their recent orders, invoices and open activities. Summarise relationship health, outstanding balance, and any risks or opportunities.
A one-page executive summary across the business.

Act as my chief of staff. Produce a one-page executive summary for the last week: sales won and lost, cash position, operational bottlenecks, and anything that needs my attention. Use aggregates, keep it to a single page, and lead with the three things that matter most.
Discover what is available before diving in.
Help me explore my Odoo data. Start with list_capabilities and list_models to see what is accessible, read the business context, then propose five useful questions you could answer for me right now.
